picked_rationale.C2: C2 directly operationalizes the core SemanticLens capability — placing components in the CLIP joint image-text semantic space so that they are text-queryable (P2a MRR=0.898). The method-swap dimension was selected: within the Multi-Modal / CLIP-Dissect family, the only genuine within-family swap is CRP-compose (adding Zennit LRP-epsilon relevance cropping before CLIP embedding), as activation-weighted mean pooling was already run in the main experiment (M3/M4, MRR=0.898 — same result as mean pool, not a genuine swap). CRP-compose tests whether the high MRR is robust when background/scene correlations are removed by component-conditioned relevance crops. C2 was selected over C1 by importance: it is the more scientifically central claim (C2 operationalizes the mechanism; C1 audits a downstream evaluation property) and the method-swap axis is directly applicable to C2's core metric (text-query MRR).

variant_selected.swap_description: CLIP-Dissect plain mean-pool → CLIP-Dissect + Zennit-CRP compose (LRP-epsilon crop before CLIP embedding)
